row.proto: void Snd_Request_JobWorker(void *worker, uint32_t job_type, uint32_t count)
row.notes: Wwise job worker request callback (AkJobMgrSettings fnRequestJobWorker; the sound engine init 0x143fbf830 stores its address at 0x143fbf90e; no direct calls). rcx = worker function void(uint32 job_type, uint32 usec), edx = job type, r8d = workers requested. Sets the Wwise max active workers of job types 1 and 2 to the worker count (0x146c64290), then under g_Snd_JobWorkerLock hands each requested worker to an idle worker mailbox (12 of 0x30 bytes at 0x146c63bd0: +0x00 thread id, +0x08 fn, +0x10 wake event signalled by 0x14391cdd0, +0x24 type, +0x28 busy flag; the calling thread's own mailbox is skipped) and queues the rest in g_Snd_JobWorkerOverflow at the first free of 24 slots (loop cmp rax,0x4a8 at 0x143fbdde4), adding 1 to g_Snd_JobWorkerPending per entry. Snd_Run_JobWorkerThread drains only overflow slots 0-11, so an entry queued in slots 12-23 never runs and the pending count never returns to 0.
